description: Allocation of Plots of Land from Regional Industrial Estates for Investors to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estate Development Programme is a major programme implemented with the aim of promoting industries at the regional level. The selection of investors for the same is done after a full evaluation of the relevant project proposals by the 'Regional Industrial Services Committee' established under the provisions of the Industrial Promotion Act No. 46 of 1990 and the 'Ministerial Project Evaluation Committee' appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development. Accordingly, the said Committees have studied 16 project proposals received and have recommended the allocation of plots of land from 09 Regional Industrial Estates for the implementation of those projects. The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to allocate the proposed plots of land to the relevant investors on long-term lease basis of 35 years as per the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.
